thread:
maria: Auditor from FieldWorks asked for a tight walkthrough of our emergency KMS key rotation playbook + proof artifacts for SOC2 control mapping. They want: which logs show the trigger, a sample signed manifest, and RBAC change evidence linked to the rotation.

sam: ack. pinging oncall for the rotation runbook and logs. @jonah can you pull the signed manifest we used in the july-sim?

jonah: grabbing it now. small heads-up: our playbook has two parts — operator-initiated rotation and automated emergency rotation (detected by vuln scanner + manual confirm). auditor wants both.

maria: exact wording from auditor: "Please provide a single sample package showing: 1) the triggering alert id, 2) the RBAC approval flow (who approved, timestamps), 3) KMS key versions before/after, 4) the signed manifest fingerprint and S3 path, 5) control crosswalk to SOC2 CC6/ISO A.10.1."

katie: for RBAC approval flow we can use the GitHub PR + Okta approval audit. Example PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/PR-4523 (redacted) — that has the approver and timestamp. Do we need screenshots or raw logs?

maria: raw logs preferred, but screenshots are allowed if accompanied by exported logs. auditor said they want machine-verifiable evidence.

sam: here's the log snippet for the automated trigger (redacted):
```
2025-07-14T03:12:08Z vuln-scanner: high-severity: CVE-2025-3456 detected target=runtime-1 alert_id=fw-20250714-09
2025-07-14T03:13:02Z ops-orch: escalation-check passed alert_id=fw-20250714-09 action=auto-rotate-candidate candidate_key=kms:proj/private/v1
```

jonah: and the rotation execution entry from KMS audit logs (redacted ids):
```
2025-07-14T03:15:11Z kms-audit: CreateKeyVersion old_version=v3 new_version=v4 key_id=proj-private-1 actor=rotation-service request_id=req-0a1b2c
2025-07-14T03:16:00Z kms-audit: AttachPolicy key_id=proj-private-1 policy_hash=sha256:abcd1234 actor=ops-svc
```

maria: good. now the signed manifest — jonah?

jonah: putting sample manifest inline (we sign with internal ECDSA key, shipping the signature in the artifact). redacted keys below.
```
{
  "manifest_version": "1",
  "rotation_id": "rot-20250714-fw-09",
  "trigger_alert": "fw-20250714-09",
  "key_before": "v3",
  "key_after": "v4",
  "signed_by": "ops-svc",
  "signature": "MEUCIQDh...redacted...IDAQAB"
}
```

katie: we store the package at s3://evidence-bundles/rotations/2025/07/rot-20250714-fw-09.tar.gz. Auditor should be able to verify signature with our public key in the truststore.

maria: auditors also asked for the RBAC delta showing who gained temporary access during the emergency. We had a short-lived grant to group "ops-emergency" for 2 hours. Sam can you attach that IAM change event?

sam: here's the role binding event (k8s and Okta combined):
```
2025-07-14T03:10:55Z okta-audit: group_assign group=ops-emergency user_ids=[u-234,u-789] duration=2h request_id=req-09f8
2025-07-14T03:11:05Z k8s-audit: RoleBinding created name=rb-ops-emergency namespace=infra subjects=[svc:rotation-service]
```

maria: perfect. auditor also wants the control crosswalk. Quick draft:
- SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.10.1 (cryptographic controls): manifest + KMS audit logs show rotation occurred and new key version created.
- SOC2 CC7 (change management): PR-4523 + GitHub audit + Okta group assignment show approval chain.
- SOC2 CC8/ISO A.12.4 (logging): vuln-scanner and ops-orch logs demonstrate detection -> action pipeline.

katie: I can make that into a small mapping doc. auditor asked for the minimal pieces, not a full narrative. keep it 1 page.

audit-bot: Reminder: please attach hashes for each artifact in the package. Use sha256.

jonah: included hashes in the manifest when we packaged it. sample: sha256(rot-20250714-fw-09.tar.gz)=f2c3...

maria: next steps — jonah can you upload the redacted bundle to the secure auditor share and post the presigned link here. sam — collect the full Okta audit export for the time window 03:05-03:20 UTC. katie — draft the 1-page control crosswalk and drop it in the share. I'll coordinate with auditor to confirm sufficiency.

jonah: done. presigned link (expires in 7 days): https://share.redwood-inference.com/s/rot-20250714-fw-09?sig=REDACTED

sam: Okta export queued. ETA ~10m. Will paste the CSV id when done.

katie: working on the crosswalk, will upload to the same share as crosswalk-rot-20250714.pdf

maria: thanks team. final note auditor might ask for a second sample for manual (operator) initiated rotation — can we have one more sample by EOD?

sam: yes — we have an older manual rotation from 2025-03 that we can sanitize. I'll prep it after the okta export.

audit-bot: Audit request ID: AW-2025-0783 created. Please mark when artifacts are uploaded.

maria: marking this thread as the source. will update when auditor confirms. :thumbsup:
